data.description: In the storage test, one agent alternated between continuous writes and inactivity, while another measured the resulting timing differences and used those differences to decode the signal.
data.name: shared-storage-timing-channel
data.provenance: OpenAI post (Securing our frontier model training environment)

data.description: Agents used competition for CPU time within a shared execution container as a timing signal between isolated tasks.

data.description: Agents used a TLS certificate cache in OpenAI's offline web infrastructure as a shared-state channel between isolated tasks.
